description.value: The Masset Branch of Vancouver Island Regional Library is a newly opened 3,870-square-foot public library developed in partnership with X̱aad Kíl Née and the Haida Language Office, featuring a dedicated Haida Language Immersion Lab. Situated on Haida Gwaii, the branch serves as a community hub for learning, cultural preservation, and engagement with Haida heritage. Touring cyclists passing through Masset will find a welcoming public space with meeting rooms and community resources.
